nodes.text: @AnnieTehworst @MailOnline yes the common cold. I was trying to be generous saying Flu BUT NO common cold....    Human metapneumovirus (hMPV) is one of the viruses that causes the common cold (upper respiratory infection). It usually makes people only mildly sick, but it can make some people very sick.
